cohort: 500 neonates in the Department of Biochemistry, COM&SDH, and Kamarhati, India.
finding: The incidence of congenital hypothyroidism was 0.8%, identified through elevated cord blood TSH followed by serum TSH and fT4 measurements on day 3.
mod_finding: 1.27% of neonates born via normal delivery and 1.87% born via cesarean section had elevated cord blood TSH levels.
birth_weight: 68.2% of neonates weighed 2.5-2.99 kg, and 29.4% were low birth weight.
